messages:
carmen.p: Quick one 7 7 My team member Sam called in sick for Dec 24-27 but Dec 26 is a company holiday in his region. He used 8 hours of sick and wants to keep the holiday as paid (not charge sick). Manager approved covering days but asked whether the holiday should be auto-applied or if we need a manual correction.
hr-bot: Heads up: regional company holidays are applied automatically to scheduled workdays when flagged in HRIS. If an employee is on paid sick leave that overlaps a recognized holiday, policy states the holiday takes precedence and sick should not be consumed for that day. Link: https://redwood.company/policies/pto#holidays
leo_mgr: I approved the sick in Lattice since Sam was unwell. I didn't indicate anything about the holiday on the request. Should I update the entry or will People Ops handle it?
olivia-peopleops: We'll handle the reconciliation but need a quick manager note so audit trail is clear. Please add: "Sick 12/24-12/27; 12/26 is regional holiday - please preserve holiday and do not charge sick for 12/26." That prevents accidental charge.
paul.payroll: Payroll/process note: our system normally auto-applies holidays on the payroll calendar; however if sick was entered and approved before the holiday calendar was posted, we sometimes see sick consumed. If you add the manager note before Dec 20 cutoff, we'll flag it for manual recon and ensure Jan payroll corrects balances. Encashment/adjustments handled as exception entries.
leo_mgr: Note added in Lattice. Copied text: "Sick 12/24-12/27; 12/26 regional holiday - preserve holiday; do not deduct sick for 12/26. Manager: Leo."
carmen.p: Thanks. Also Sam mentioned he might need short-term disability (STD) if out longer than 7 days. Do we trigger anything now or only if it goes beyond the waiting period?
olivia-peopleops: STD triggers after 7 consecutive calendar days of disability per policy. If it looks like it'll extend beyond that please file an LOA/STD intake now so we can prep benefits & paperwork. For overlapping holiday days, STD back-dates to first eligible day but holiday pay still applies per benefit coordination rules.
paul.payroll: We'll watch the timecard. If staff files STD and it's retroactive, payroll will adjust balances and pay codes on the next off-cycle. Please escalate to People Ops as soon as intake is started.
hr-bot: people-ops ticket created: #PO-7822  olivia-peopleops assigned. Link: https://redwood.company/people-ops/tickets/PO-7822
carmen.p: Closing loop - manager note added, Sam informed that holiday will be preserved and that he can open an STD intake if symptoms continue. Thanks all.
